requirements.requirement: Create the local account `contractor` on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was absent initially, then directly observed with UID/GID 1000, `/home/contractor`, `/bin/bash`, and correctly owned home directory; it remained present after restart.

requirements.requirement: Configure `contractor` with a 60-day maximum password age and a 10-day expiration warning.
requirements.summary: Direct shadow, password-status, and `chage` observations show a set password, maximum age 60 days, and warning period 10 days both before and after restart.

overall_summary: All public task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide node-restart protocol is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged a scheduled reboot, showed a bounded connection disruption, returned with a different boot identity, and recovered its running system, SSH service, account, home directory, and password-aging policy. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account creation and password-policy changes directly implemented the task; the synchronized, transiently scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. The remaining commands were read-only recovery checks or expected failed connection attempts during reboot. Post-execution observations show no failed services, new exposure, package damage, or unwanted temporary residue.
